description: A rounded-rectangle block (40 x 40, R8 corners, 20 high) with a 2 mm chamfer round its bottom loop, then an Extrude Cut of its whole top face 5 mm down. The tool's walls, its corner cylinders included, lay on the block's walls; only straight profile edges were grown off the walls, so the cut failed with 'no result' (#1275). Result: the block 15 high, less the chamfer.
